items.en: Mothball

Mothballed %ss can't be used in combat or repaired, and do not provide any fuel, cargo, or personnel capacity.\n\nMothballing a ship will reduce its combat readiness to zero; restoring it will require time and supplies.

Mothballed %ss can't be used in combat or repaired, and do not provide any fuel, cargo, or personnel capacity.\n\nRestoring this ship's combat readiness after unmothballing it will consume %s supplies over %s day(s).
Scuttle
Strip this %s of anything useful, gaining %d supplies, %d fuel, and %d heavy machinery.
Suspend Repairs & Recovery
Prevents this %s from performing repairs or recovering combat readiness. Full repairs and CR recovery will consume approximately %s supplies over %s days if allowed to proceed.
Prevents this %s from performing repairs or recovering combat readiness. This %s does not currently require repairs or CR recovery.
Refit
Change the weapons and hullmods equipped on this ship.
Logistical Priority
%ss with logistical priority get first pick of crew and supplies available for repairs.
Elite
Crew this %s with the best personnel available.
Veteran
Crew this %s with only veteran crew and below, if possible.
Regular
Crew this %s with only regular crew and below, if possible.
Green
Crew this %s only with green crew, if possible.
Crew fraction on this %s.
